% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): TikZ keys on the axis apply to the
% whole axis (box line width, text font); minor x ticks from a list and a
% tick distance.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[thick, font=\small, xtick distance=0.5, minor xtick={0.25,0.75,1.25}, xlabel={Small}]
\addplot coordinates {(0,0) (1,1) (2,0)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
